title: AgentCE quarantine record
description: One record of quarantine.jsonl (SPEC Appendix F): an ingested item the engine refused, with the stable reason code. The file carries one such JSON object per line; this schema validates a single record.

event_id.description: The id of the offending event, when it has one.

type.description: The declared event type, when known.

detail.description: Human-readable detail; the reason code is the stable part.
